gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Tight and striking, Expose crowds its caps right against the lowercase, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian lets big open eyes breathe beneath it. Text runs smooth and unhurried.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Expose packs its letters into a compressed, refined display line with barely a pause between them. Its strongest quality is that tension against Noto Sans Kaithi, a plain sans whose lowercase fills the line almost like capitals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada feels approachable, with a gentle step up from small letters to capitals. Under Expose, its wide-open s curves meet a compressed, refined display heading, and the two sit together like a quiet voice beside a sharp one.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Expose keeps its caps and lowercase nearly shoulder to shoulder, a compressed and striking heading. Noto Sans Kayah Li is a plain sans with lifted brush ends, so give its text a comfortable size and let the heading stay snug.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Approachable and contemporary, the text here has curves that never close back on themselves. Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, which gives a long read some real weight under Expose's compressed heading.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer reads modern and clean, its small letters standing proud and nearly capital-sized. Noto Sans Khmer keeps a long stretch of text open and easy to move through, with generous notches that let light in beneath Expose.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki reads clean and modern, with exits wide enough to pass light through and a large eye on every e. And Expose sits above it as the tight, striking voice, so the text underneath feels like a deep breath.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Expose is the refined, striking one, its caps pressed close to the lowercase in a compressed display line. Noto Sans Khudawadi does the opposite job, a plain sans with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, made to be read.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR reads clean and contemporary, with generous gaps in its curves and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. And Expose supplies the compressed, refined heading above it, so the page has one tight voice and one open one.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao reads modern, with an x-height pushed well above the usual and mouths that stay open on c, e, and a. Noto Sans Lao carries a long page lightly, a relaxed counterpart to the tightly packed Expose.
